decision: Do not call the 16-hour design conditionally feasible until either a conservative completed-device current bound is at or below 4.4mA or five complete units pass the battery-side 16-hour integral. Keep the fixed battery and requirements; optimize the design rather than relaxing them.

current_firmware_before_this_change.audio_clock: MSIK at 3.072MHz, continuously requested by ADF
current_firmware_before_this_change.problem: HSI16 and MSIK were both active during recording, while the 2.4135mA MCU/codec/crypto/regulator allocation had no calculation or measurement behind it.

implemented_power_change.storage_clock: PCLK2 at 16MHz through SPI1; 62.5kHz initialization and 4MHz transfer rates retained
implemented_power_change.hsi16: explicitly off after startup and rejected by recorder boot preflight
implemented_power_change.scope: Removes a continuously enabled oscillator without reducing sample rate, CPU frequency, SPI transfer speed, encryption, or recording continuity.
verification: Mock startup test covers MSIS16 selection, HSI-off and fail-closed checks.
Recorder boot mock rejects an invalid clock profile.
ICACHE one-way startup is fail-closed and covered by seven mock cases.
The configured common U585 factory image links successfully with the pinned ICACHE HAL driver.

official_mcu_evidence.package_regulator_path: The selected STM32U585CIU6 has no external SMPS in the board design, so LDO tables are the relevant conservative reference.
limitations: The tables disable all peripherals and do not include ADF, LPDMA, MSIK, GPIO switching, actual SRAM retention, IMA ADPCM, age encryption, SPI, storage, microphone, guards, LDO loss or board leakage.
The Run table assumes ICACHE one-way and prefetch. ICACHE one-way is now required at startup; prefetch and completed-device duty/current remain unverified.
Typical values are not production bounds and the device duty cycle has not been measured.
The MCU maximum alone can exceed the complete-device 4.4mA target at elevated junction temperature; a qualified 16-hour operating-temperature envelope must therefore be established physically.

remaining_high_leverage_work: Measure battery, storage rail and non-storage rail current on the exact configured image before changing more architecture.
Measure CPU awake duty, audio queue high-water mark and 5-second commit latency; use these to decide whether ICACHE and tickless/Stop0 scheduling are required.
Do not enter Stop2 merely from compile evidence: continuous ADF/LPDMA capture, SRAM placement, HAL time, USB events and storage recovery must remain correct.
If any complete unit exceeds 4.4mA average, remove the 1ms idle wakeups with a qualified monotonic time source and remeasure; do not change the battery or recording contract.
